headline: Nigeria's Fidelity Bank redeems $400 million Eurobond at maturity
summary: Fidelity Bank Plc successfully repaid its $400 million 5-year senior unsecured Eurobond, carrying a 7.625% annual coupon, upon its maturity on October 28.
why: Fidelity Bank is a major commercial bank listed on the Nigerian Exchange.

impacts.name: Fidelity Bank Plc
impacts.why: Meeting international debt obligations confirms solid liquidity and capital management.
